methodologyNotes: Roster covers thirteen real, currently-or-recently sold knife sharpeners spanning guided clamp systems, rod/ceramic sharpeners, rolling sharpeners, electric sharpeners, and a wet-grinder, verified 2026-08-11 against manufacturer product pages (Work Sharp, Wicked Edge, Lansky, Spyderco, Tumblerware, Chef'sChoice/EdgeCraft, Tormek, KME Sharpeners, Edge Pro Inc., HORL) and corroborating retailers (KnifeCenter, DLT Trading, Sharpening Supplies, BNB Knives, Amazon); the two seed names "Trizor XV EdgeSelect" and "Chef'sChoice Trizor XV" resolve to the same physical product (Chef'sChoice/EdgeCraft Model 15XV, 3-stage 15° Trizor system, marketed interchangeably as "Trizor XV" and "Trizor XV EdgeSelect"), so they were merged into a single entry rather than duplicated, leaving thirteen unique products; prices are the clearest current manufacturer or authorized-dealer figure found, with priceNote recording list-vs-sale spread where observed (e.g. Wicked Edge Pro Pack II is now discontinued and sold at a marked-down clearance price; Tormek and KME do not publish direct consumer MSRP, so an authorized-dealer price is used instead).
